name: Mountain Ride: Snowboard
subtitle: Endless Downhill & Tricks
promotionalText: Strap in, swipe across five lanes, jump glacier crevasses and take on your friends in a live duel. There's a brand-new daily race every day!
shortDescription: Endless 3D snowboard runner: tricks, combos, duels and a daily race.
description:
How far down the mountain can you go? Mountain Ride is an endless 3D snowboard runner in portrait mode – made to play with one hand.

CONTROLS
• Swipe left or right to switch between five lanes
• Swipe up or tap to jump
• Swipe down to duck under banners

TRICKS & COMBOS
• In the air: tap = 360° spin, swipe up = backflip, swipe down = grab
• Mix different tricks in one jump and land clean to chain combos: ×2, ×3 …

A MOUNTAIN THAT GROWS WITH YOU
• Obstacles arrive in stages and ramp up gently: trees and rocks first, then logs and ramps, banners, fences and rolling snowballs, glacier crevasses – and finally everything at once, faster and faster
• Track sections keep every run fresh: deep powder slows you down, ice sheets are fast and slippery, plus snow tunnels and steep slopes

FOUR PLACES TO RIDE
• Alps – sunshine and a changing time of day
• Forest Run – carve your way down through the woods
• Torch Night – a night ride between burning torches
• Glacier – blue ice towers and deep crevasses

POWER-UPS, SHOP & MISSIONS
• Magnet, shield, turbo, double points and super jump – upgrade them with coins in the shop
• Snowboards in lots of colours, snow trails (rainbow included), start shield and turbo start
• Missions with coin rewards

RIDE AGAINST OTHERS
• Duel by link: send a friend a link and they ride the exact same course against your ghost
• Live duel: two players, same course, same time – see each other live (room code)
• Daily race: one course a day for everyone, with its own daily leaderboard
• Worldwide leaderboard

ALSO
• Plays offline (only online leaderboards and duels need a connection)
• Available in 10 languages

Mountain Ride is free to play. Ads are optional: watch a rewarded video for a second chance or double coins. Optional in-app purchases: coin packs, no ads and a starter pack.

3D trees made with Meshy (meshy.ai).
whatsNew: First release: endless downhill runs, 4 places, tricks and combos, power-ups, duel by link, live duel, daily race and a worldwide leaderboard. Enjoy the ride!
